historical_record.description: A building contract was recorded for excavating, bulkheading and plain reinforced concrete work for a six-storey Class C apartment building. M. V. Politeo was named as architect and Anderson & Ringrose as contractors.

A building contract was recorded for steam heating, piping and radiators for a six-storey Class C building with a basement, at $3,650. M. V. Politeo was named as architect and the Scott Co. as contractor.
A building contract was recorded for steel and iron work for a Class C apartment building, at $14,750. M. V. Politeo was named as architect and the Judson Mfg. Co. as contractor.
